name: Tremolo
description: Amplitude movement four ways: amp tremolo, auto-pan, the brownface harmonic tremolo that shimmers instead of pulsing, and pitch vibrato.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Tremolo pulses the volume, Pan moves the sound from side to side, Harmonic rocks between dark and bright, Vibrato bends the pitch.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How fast the movement cycles. Slow is a sway; fast is a shudder.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How strong the movement is. At full, Tremolo dips to silence and Pan swings hard left and right.

params.name: Shape
params.description: The curve of the movement. Sine and Triangle are even, Square switches between two levels, Random glides to a new level each cycle.

params.name: Stereo Phase
params.description: Moves the right side out of step with the left, so the pulsing travels across the stereo field. Has no effect in Pan mode.

params.name: Crossover
params.description: Where Harmonic mode splits the sound into the lows and highs that trade places. The other modes do not use it.

params.name: Drift
params.description: Lets the rate wander slowly faster and slower, so the pulse is never perfectly regular. Zero is steady.

params.name: Smooth
params.description: Rounds off the corners of the shape. Low keeps Square choppy; high softens every shape into a gentler swell.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the untouched signal and the moving one. Lower settings make the effect shallower.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The harmonic mode follows the idea of the early-sixties Fender brownface circuit (a low and a high band modulated in opposite phase), not its schematic.
